{{Quote|Jackpot! Jackpot!|A winner at the Spiral Galaxy|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Spiral Galaxy''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Vulta]].

==Description==
The Spiral Galaxy was located on a busy street near the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]]. It was filled with smoke, shouts, flashing lights, and [[Music/Legends|music]]. It also had a bar in it.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
[[Zeerid Korr]] and [[Aryn Leneer]] went to the Spiral Galaxy to talk where no one would hear them. They sat at a corner table in the bar area and discussed Aryn going with Zeerid to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When he found out that his cargo was ready to go, he finally said that Aryn could go with him. They quickly left the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] when they noticed several people watching them.<ref name="TOR" />
